notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least 8.
description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least eight {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, causing Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to become a creature and untapping it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
